parent_policy: observed_admission_completion (the selected unchanged control), not the rejected allocation auction or reentry families
evidence: Actual pre-2026 filled campaigns of the selected control were reconciled without a new portfolio replay. Comparing the existing support with its value Config.fast sessions earlier, declining-support admissions numbered 7/7/6 in union/common-five/joint-leader-removal. Their closed-campaign mean PnL/buy-notional was 0.05044278405451092/-0.035762330050854566/-0.07954013705078662 versus 0.06207157344378055/0.1654076840708932/0.049552605973399215 for the remaining cohorts. Declining-support union trades still contributed positive cash PnL; withholding them has a real opportunity cost. These small descriptive cohorts are not causal treatment effects or independent return samples. The new account comparison must determine whether delayed admission, replacement selection, cash and NAV-dependent risk interactions actually improve the joint result.
hypothesis: An upward fast signal can occur before a recently broken support base has repaired. Test withholding only new admissions while the same observed support floor remains below its value one existing fast window earlier. This is a prospective economic eligibility choice, not a bug correction, a stop relaxation, or a claim that every excluded trade loses money.
control: Unchanged observed_admission_completion with the same construction-time Config and actual-account lifecycle.
treatment: On the parent's positive-allocation path only, retain the original allowed mask and additionally exclude an unheld symbol when both its current expanding 20-session support and the support Config.fast sessions earlier are finite and current support is strictly lower. Equality is stable. If the earlier estimate does not exist, preserve the parent's original expanding-history admission rule; do not invent pre-2023 history or add a new warmup. Never add eligibility, alter ranking, force a sale, resize existing units, or filter held additions. The unchanged parent still requires breakout for additions to held positions. Recompute the condition each completed session; no new cooldown, fitted constant, future label or per-symbol rule.
obligations: Keep all original actual cash, total stop-risk, slot, name/sector and materiality limits, stop floors, protective exits/retries, economic reduction ceilings, actual-NAV risk history, recovery conditions, next-session execution, T+1, costs and liquidity constraints. The mask may only remove fresh purchase opportunities; it cannot cancel existing protective obligations or spend unexecuted sale proceeds. Initialize the specialized allocator before the first observation; do not replace live state.
trace: Preserve each withheld opportunity's signal date, session, symbol, actual units, original allowed mask, current and lagged support, history availability and withheld mask in the same source-bound trace as original obligations and completion. Intent is not a fill.
selection: Use unchanged finite_study pre-2026 three-scope minimax deficit, objective and fill ordering, identical baseline accounts, costs, dates and data. Exactly the two declared candidates. Retain both raw outcomes; a selected control is not a treatment success. Do not stitch winners by pool or change any old frozen family.
evaluation: Evaluate the selected single candidate under the unchanged full, bull, late-June-through-August, July-August and retrospective-2026 windows. Original native references, original pools, contributor/industry removals, fixed subsets and sizes, costs/delays, parameter neighborhoods and causal-prefix checks remain required before production promotion. Core nonregression is not original economic acceptance.
verification: only unheld opportunities can be removed
no original eligibility can be added
protection and partial fills take precedence
limitations: All observed history including 2026 is retrospective. Preserve rejected auction, reentry and other evidence. Adjusted units remain a proxy rather than a complete actual-share/corporate-action/tax ledger. No private reference implementation is imported.
